method: source identity and official API/CLI applicability

actual_dependencies.CalicoPolicyCli: Explicit kubectl plus datastore-specific, server-matched calicoctl; projectcalico.org/v3 HEP/GNP and networking.k8s.io/v1 NetworkPolicy
actual_dependencies.KubeBackupCli: Python SDK35.0.0 CoreV1/AppsV1/BatchV1/VersionApi/DynamicClient; 17 stable built-in API mappings; custom resources require actual discovery
actual_dependencies.KubePublishCli: Docker28.5.2 or nerdctl2.3.4 namespace/save/load plus existing SSH transport; no Kubernetes resource API

decision: Keep these byte-identical tools and dependencies; new Kubernetes/calicoctl/runtime identities need only affected API/CLI integration through their own tools entry point.
reuse_boundary: No tools implementation or build change; no inherited upgrade PASS relabelled as TOOLS delivery PASS. Existing tools matrix remains authoritative; no full tools build/regression prerequisite for core upgrade.
minimal_gaps: CalicoPolicyCli existing policy plan/validate and allow/deny against matched calicoctl after target network convergence
KubeBackupCli small isolated stable-resource backup/restore including resource identity and SDK VersionApi; custom CR discovery only if source configuration uses it
KubePublishCli one small image save/load/readback for changed containerd path with retained nerdctl; unchanged Docker deep transport scenarios inherited by applicability
